premise: Dog's beach ball rolls away to the water; he gets splashed chasing it, Seal pops up and nudges it back, and the two of them play ball across the waves.
inspiration: The lost-and-returned motif of folk tale (the golden ball at the well), freed of any bargain: the stranger who brings it back just wants to play.
lesson: A lost thing can bring a new friend.

en-US.title: The Ball and the Seal
en-US.text: {dog:enter} Dog had a {ball:enter} ball, red and yellow and blue and white, and he loved it more than anything. {dog:face happy} He nudged it with his nose. {sfx:boing} Boing! {ball:go to shore} Away it rolled, bouncing down to the water's edge. {dog:face surprised} [excited] Come back, ball! {dog:go to shore} Dog raced after it. SPLASH! A wave splashed him from his nose to his tail. {dog:live} Dog shook himself, shake, shake, shake! [short pause] The ball sat bobbing in the foam. Then a grey head popped up. {seal:enter by swim} It was Seal. {seal:face happy} She gave the ball a push with her nose, {ball:go to dog} and it rolled right back to Dog. {ball:live} It spun round, and stopped at his paws. {dog:face happy} {dog:hop x2} Dog gave it a nudge back. {ball:go to seal} Seal pushed it back again. {seal:live} She clapped her flippers. Arf! [laughs] And that's how Dog found out that seals are very, very good at ball.

es-ES.title: La pelota y la foca
es-ES.text: {dog:enter} Perro tenía una {ball:enter} pelota, roja, amarilla, azul y blanca, y la quería más que a nada. {dog:face happy} Le dio un empujoncito con el hocico. {sfx:boing} ¡Boing! {ball:go to shore} Y allá se fue, botando hasta la orilla. {dog:face surprised} [excited] ¡Vuelve, pelota! {dog:go to shore} Perro salió corriendo detrás. ¡CHOF! Una ola lo mojó del hocico a la cola. {dog:live} Perro se sacudió, ¡sacude, sacude, sacude! [short pause] La pelota se mecía en la espuma. Entonces asomó una cabeza gris. {seal:enter by swim} Era Foca. {seal:face happy} Empujó la pelota con el hocico, {ball:go to dog} y la pelota rodó hasta Perro. {ball:live} Dio vueltas y se paró junto a sus patas. {dog:face happy} {dog:hop x2} Perro se la devolvió de un empujoncito. {ball:go to seal} Foca se la devolvió otra vez. {seal:live} Dio palmadas con las aletas. ¡Arf! [laughs] Y así descubrió Perro que las focas juegan a la pelota muy, muy bien.

boing.prompt: a beach ball bouncing once on sand, a soft rubbery boing, playful

splash.prompt: a wave splashing over a dog at the water's edge, realistic
